name: Low-Carb Korean Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, peeled and grated
Sesame seeds and chopped scallions (optional toppings)
why: Squarely mid-band on published numbers (507 cal, 2.3g carbs, 30g protein, 30g fat) and structurally low-carb: whole-muscle beef seared in a skillet with a soy/sesame marinade, zero starch base and sugar-free by design. Ribeye is a tracked board commodity (Ribeye Steak); recipe notes sirloin works too, so it stays in the beef-roast/steak lane on a mapped cut. Korean adds cuisine variety to an American/Tex-Mex-heavy catalog, and no bulgogi exists in the pool or accepted list. Scales to 14 by searing more sliced steak and batching the marinade, weigh-and-divide. Flagged unmapped: monk fruit extract, chipotle-in-adobo, adobo sauce, and tamari are deliberate pricer-lane test ingredients (tamari may map to soy sauce; the sweetener and chile-in-adobo likely have no board home).
